💡 Practical Tips

China Travel Tips

Everything you need to know before traveling – visa, weather, payments, internet, customs and traditions

💡 Practical Guide⏱️ 8 min read
Home◂Tourism in China◂Travel Tips

Traveling to China is a wonderful experience but differs from typical destinations. This guide provides all the practical information you need for a comfortable and enjoyable trip. Arcadia Tourism handles all these details on your behalf within our travel programs.

Visa 📄

China entry requirements vary by nationality and trip type. Eligible travelers may use the 240-hour visa-free transit policy under specific conditions. Always confirm the latest rules with the Chinese immigration authority or the relevant embassy before travel. Arcadia provides general information only and does not process visa applications.

Electronic Payment 💳

China relies heavily on electronic payment via Alipay and WeChat Pay. You can link your foreign bank card to these apps. We also recommend carrying a small amount of Chinese Yuan cash for smaller establishments.

Internet and VPN 📱

Some apps and websites are blocked in China (WhatsApp, Google, Instagram). We recommend downloading a VPN app before traveling, or buying an international SIM card. You can also buy a local SIM from the airport upon arrival.

Best Time to Visit 🌤️

The period between April and October is best. Avoid Golden Week (first of October) and Chinese New Year (January–February) to avoid heavy crowds. Check costs as prices rise in peak seasons.

Language and Communication 🗣️

The official language is Mandarin Chinese. In big cities you may find English speakers in hotels and airports. We recommend downloading a translation app with camera feature. With Arcadia's programs you are accompanied by an Arabic-speaking guide.

Food and Drink 🍜

Check our Halal Food Guide in China to find the best restaurants and areas. Drink bottled water only and avoid tap water. Try the local cuisine in each city – every region has a different flavor.

Safety and Security 🛡️

China is one of the safest countries for tourists. Crime rates are very low, especially violent crimes. Keep a copy of your passport and always carry your hotel address written in Chinese.

💡 Arcadia Tip

We can arrange available travel services such as accommodation, transportation, guided tours and an Arabic-speaking guide. Contact us to design a custom program that suits your needs. Entry documents remain the traveler's responsibility.
